ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Find the perimeter or circumference of the figure. Round to the nearest tenth.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a circle, inside the circle there is a black dot representing the center, and a pink line segment extends from this black dot to the circumference, labeled beside it as 4 in., so this pink line segment is the radius. Reasoning: The problem asks to find the perimeter/circumference of the figure and round to the nearest tenth. The circumference formula of a circle is C = 2πr. Substituting r = 4 gives C = 2π(4) = 8π ≈ 25.1327, which rounded to the nearest tenth is 25.1.
